messages:
anna_arch: Heads-up — I observed an oscillation this morning: regional probe spikes + tenant burst => route shim shifted traffic to a cold region, preempted canaries, then flipped back once probe settled. stack traces attached but TL;DR: policy weight updates + probe signal smoothing are too tight.

mike_eng: ugh. do you have the sample logs? curious if this is probe staleness or a scoring bug.

anna_arch: pasted a small snippet: ```probe: {region: eu-west, latency_p50: 210ms, penalty: 0.22} policy_weights_before: {eu-west:0.4,us-east:0.6} policy_weights_after: {eu-west:0.9,us-east:0.1}``` note the penalty calc used a raw probe and applied directly to weight.

samir: that direct apply is the issue. our smoothing window is 5s and probe sampling is every 1s for some regions. When a tenant bursts, sampling amplifies transient load and penalty becomes sticky due to immediate weight reassign.

ella_reliability: quick suggestion: introduce a transient-backoff token bucket per-region that gates weight changes for N seconds after a >X% delta. Alternatively, require at least two consecutive probe samples above threshold before promoting region penalties.

mike_eng: +1 to token bucket idea. implementation sketch: add field `weight_cooldown_until` on route snapshot and don't let weight change > delta_threshold until cooldown expires. Also consider making it tenant-aware: bursty tenants get soft caps so they don't drag global route choices.

samir: tenant-aware soft caps are important. ops observed last week that a single noisy tenant flipped our dedicated vs hosted prioritization. Proposed rule: if tenant qps > reserved_pool_qps * 0.3 then apply tenant_soft_cap multiplier 0.5 to their route scoring.

anna_arch: sounds good. tradeoffs: might underutilize capacity if long tails; need metrics to detect false positives. Let's add an observability flag: `route_decision_reason` in traces so we can see if caps fired.

ella_reliability: also add a simulation-mode flag for the policy engine so we can run new cooldown parameters in shadow and measure decision churn before rollout.

mike_eng: ops action items: (1) add cooldown token-bucket prototype in shim (owner: @mike_eng, ETA: EOD Friday), (2) add tenant soft-cap heuristic (owner: @samir, ETA: next Tue), (3) surface `route_decision_reason` in console (owner: @ella_reliability, ETA: next Wed).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-6493 for cooldown prototype; assigned to mike_eng; priority P2.

anna_arch: thanks — will follow up with a tiny RFC describing the cooldown semantics and simulation metrics. If anyone has objections to the cooldown-first approach speak now, otherwise we'll iterate in RFC.
